name: 17745 · Lock Haven, PA
findings: ZIP 17745 (Lock Haven) has 84 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 17745 (Lock Haven) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
42% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 17745 (Lock Haven) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 57% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
